title: Guidelines for non -coking coals for solid reductant based direct reduction in rotary kilns(and other reactors
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11860) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Guidelines for non -coking coals for solid reductant based direct reduction in rotary kilns(and other reactors.

clause_2_normative_references.title: General requirments for the supply of metallurgical materials

Guidelines for ash softening studies on solid reductants for direct reduction
Guide for drafting and presentation of Indian Standards
Coal (Char) Reactivity for Direct Reduction Process - Method of Determination
Methods of Test for Coal and Coke, Part II: Determination of Calorific Value

clause_3_terminology: coking coals for solid reductant based direct reduction in rotary kilns

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
